Row.Text: Mana is that power that resides in chiefs – it causes the wind to blow, the storms to rage or calm, crops to come from the land…and the people to love them. But a new era brings a new line of kings, and the T’ui Ha’atakalaua struggles to assert their power over a skeptical public.
Power is prosperity. All things will be done in accordance with tapu.
Prosperity is power. Adopt new ways for a new age.

Before a vessel embarks on a long sea voyage, the talua sings a sea-song over its hull. But the council of talua wonders about aircraft: if one sings a sea-song, would this cause the aircraft to seek the sea, instead of the sky? Should there be a sky-priest, a talua langi?
